notes.title: ONE PIECE WORLD SEEKER - Patch 1.03
notes.notes:
A new patch, including free updates, will be available on July 11th for ONE PIECE WORLD SEEKER.
­­
Patch Ver. 1.03 contents:

 Added Treasure Hunting Outfit (from One Piece Stampede)
 Added new Challenge Mission (available after clearing the full game)
 Increased difficulty of Tashigi, Fujitora, Kizaru, which will be applied after clearing the full game
 Added new equipment
 Improved game balance


Thank you for your support, we hope you continue to enjoy playing ONE PIECE WORLD SEEKER!
